title: CAN LLMS DEEPLY DETECT COMPLEX MALICIOUS QUERIES? A FRAMEWORK FOR JAILBREAKING VIA OBFUSCATING INTENT
reasoning: The paper investigates the vulnerabilities of Large Language Models to jailbreak attacks that bypass safety filters. It includes an empirical evaluation across several sensitive content categories, specifically including 'Ethics', 'Racism', and 'Sexism', thereby assessing the model's ability to maintain ethical and moral alignment when faced with complex, obfuscated queries.
